prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: low-speed head-on collision in Sugar Land, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported neck strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1196; do not mention it.)
text: Officer's narrative. On arrival at the scene in Sugar Land, Texas, I observed a low-speed head-on collision between two passenger vehicles in the eastbound lane of the roadway. Driver 1 was operating the northbound vehicle and Driver 2 was operating the southbound vehicle. Driver 2 had one passenger seated in the front right position. Both vehicles sustained visible front-end damage consistent with a minor impact. Airbags did not deploy in either vehicle. Both vehicles were drivable and were moved to the shoulder. Driver 1 stated that he felt immediate stiffness and discomfort in the neck following the impact and reported neck strain. Driver 1 declined transport by EMS at the scene. Driver 2 and the Passenger reported no injuries. Statements were obtained from all parties, and no citations were issued at this time pending further review of the incident.
